produced_unit_artifacts.TRAINING.json: per-epoch fit_loss, inner_loss, monitored=0.5*(fit+inner), per-head sums/counts, stale count, weights sha; best_epoch, stop_reason; monitor_evaluation {procedure i6dmo.monitor_eval.v2 (canonical_loader_rebuild monitor instance, loader_overhead_s, witness: per-batch per-head float64 partial sums + row-id batch digests + in-function code witness), batch_size (= training batch), graph inference, partition sequential_row_id_fixed, dtype, accumulation, best-epoch monitored + per-head sums/counts, self_check PASS} — the DMO10 replay MUST recompute via tools.i6dmo.train.replay_monitored(model, fit, inner, record) (shared evaluate_monitored path; any other batching is MONITOR_PATH_MISMATCH), bitwise on the same device
produced_unit_artifacts.predictions/{fit,inner,validation}.npz: row_id, horizons_hours, origin_price, predicted_price (n,6) original USD/EUR, target_price (NaN where invalid), mask

training_coordinate: y_h = (p(t+h) - p(t)) / naive_fit_h where naive_fit_h = fit-only masked mean |p(t+h)-p(t)|; the per-head loss is therefore exactly MAE_h / naive_fit_h; prediction p_hat = p(t) + yhat_h * naive_fit_h

monitor_tolerance.bound: |delta| <= 1e-9 + 5e-5*|recorded| per partial sum and for the monitored value

monitor_tolerance.justification: a reproduced, build/context-specific numerical discrepancy between in-session and fresh-instance GPU executions of this pinned TF build, cause not demonstrated (eight mechanisms excluded), bounded by the versioned NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT protocol; prospective, no past run re-graded
monitor_tolerance.activation: only with static-algorithm determinism flags recorded and equal on both sides
monitor_tolerance.outcomes: WITHIN_DECLARED_FLOOR (reported with max deltas and allowance; row-level hex stays a diagnostic in row_forward_diagnostics) vs MONITOR_WITNESS_DIVERGENCE beyond the floor (hard)
